messages:
Jamie Park: Hey everyone — first week here! Quick checklist Q: I still don’t have Salesforce access, Gong invite, or the new rep playbook. Who should I ping to get these turned on? :wave:
Anika Patel: @Jamie welcome! :tada: People Ops kicks off accounts but Sales Ops + your manager do app access. I’ll DM you the onboarding ticket link.
Marco Ruiz: I’ll take Salesforce and Outreach. Marco Ruiz: Jamie, can you confirm your company email? I’ll raise the provisioning request (should be same day).
Jamie Park: Thanks Marco — jamie.park@redwood.ai is the email.
Marco Ruiz: Got it. I created ticket SOPS-5421 and added you as requester. ETA for SF access: 1 business day. Also added incoming instructions for 2FA.
Priya Shah: For Gong and call recording, we need the Gong onboarding form filled out. Priya Shah: Link: https://redwood-internal/gong/onboard (internal). Put your preferred outbound dialer (Outreach/HubSpot).
Jamie Park: I use Outreach at my last company — happy to stick with that if it’s supported.
Elena Moreno: Outreach is the standard for SDR/AE here. Elena Moreno: I’ll add you to the shared sequences folder and give you a quick template pack.
Anika Patel: Collateral: package with pitch decks, one-pagers, and case studies is in Notion: https://redwood-internal/notion/sales-collateral. You should be in the viewer group; if not, tell me.
Jamie Park: Notion link works. I can’t download the PDF pitch deck though (permission error).
Marco Ruiz: Permission glitch — fixed. Try again and confirm.
Jamie Park: Works now, thanks!
Priya Shah: Playbook: we have a short "first-30-days" playbook for AEs. Priya Shah: Key items: 1) CRM hygiene rules (mandatory), 2) cold-call scripts (editable), 3) escalation matrix. I’ll paste the intro snippet below:
Priya Shah: ```
Do this week 1: 1) Import leads from shared list, 2) Run through two mock calls with Elena, 3) Complete Salesforce hygiene checklist.
Do by week 2: shadow 3 customer calls, start 6 outbound sequences/day.
```
Jamie Park: Love that — can you add me to the mock call rota?
Elena Moreno: Yep — added you for Wednesday 2pm PT. I’ll ping Zoom link 15m before.
OpsBot: SYSTEM: New user onboarding checklist created (ticket SOPS-5421). Status: In progress.
Marco Ruiz: One more: if you want mobile SSO for Salesforce, let me know device type and I’ll set up Okta push.
Jamie Park: iPhone 14, iOS 16.4.
Marco Ruiz: Noted. Will add mobile auth tomorrow.
Jamie Park: Appreciate all the quick help — this is super smooth. One last ask: is there a short sales cheat sheet for integrations and pricing tiers?
Anika Patel: Yes — pricebook cheat sheet is in the collateral folder. Anika Patel: Filename: "Pricebook_quick_ref_v2.pdf". If anything missing, tag @revenue-ops.
Priya Shah: Also, for customer success handoffs, use the internal template: https://redwood-internal/notion/cs-handoff. Priya Shah: Fill in required fields exactly or handoffs get delayed.
Jamie Park: Got it. Thanks everyone :pray:
Elena Moreno: Welcome again! Ping any time for role-specific tips or mock calls. :thumbsup:
